title: Figma Basics — Build a Login Screen Step by Step
description: Create a professional mobile login screen in Figma from scratch, learning frames, shapes, text, Auto Layout, and components
objective: Students will create a complete mobile login screen in Figma using frames, Auto Layout, components, and proper design principles

steps.title: Create the Frame
steps.instructions:
Open Figma → create a new design file.

Press **F** (Frame tool) → on the right panel, select **iPhone 14 (390 × 844)**.

Set the background color to `#F8FAFC` (light gray).

Rename the frame to "Login Screen" in the left panel (double-click the name).

steps.title: Add the Logo Section
steps.instructions:
Press **R** (Rectangle) → draw a 64×64 square inside the frame.
- Corner radius: 16
- Fill: `#6366F1` (indigo)

Press **T** (Text) → type "T" on top of the rectangle.
- Font: Inter Bold, 32px
- Color: White
- Center it on the rectangle

Select both (rectangle + text) → **Ctrl+G** to group → rename to "Logo".

Press **T** again → below the logo, type:
- "TechPath" — Inter Bold, 28px, color `#0F172A`
- "Welcome back" — Inter Regular, 16px, color `#64748B`

Center all three elements horizontally.

Select Logo + TechPath + Welcome back → right-click → **Add Auto Layout** (Shift+A).
- Direction: Vertical
- Gap: 8
- Alignment: Center

Position this group in the upper portion of the frame.

steps.title: Build the Input Fields
steps.instructions:
Create the Email input:
1. Press **R** → draw a rectangle 342×48
   - Fill: `#FFFFFF`
   - Border: 1px solid `#E2E8F0`
   - Corner radius: 8
2. Press **T** → type "Email address" inside
   - Font: Inter Regular, 15px
   - Color: `#94A3B8` (placeholder gray)
   - Position: 16px from left edge
3. Select rectangle + text → **Shift+A** (Auto Layout)
   - Padding: 12 horizontal, 14 vertical
   - Rename to "Input - Email"

Duplicate (Ctrl+D) → change text to "Password".

Add a label above each input:
- Press **T** → "Email" — Inter Medium, 14px, color `#334155`
- Press **T** → "Password" — same style

Select both labels + inputs → **Shift+A** (Auto Layout)
- Direction: Vertical
- Gap: 16
- Rename to "Form Fields"

steps.title: Add Buttons and Links
steps.instructions:
Create the Login button:
1. Press **R** → rectangle 342×48
   - Fill: `#6366F1`
   - Corner radius: 8
   - No border
2. Press **T** → "Log In"
   - Font: Inter SemiBold, 16px
   - Color: White
   - Center on rectangle
3. Select both → **Shift+A** → Center alignment
   - Rename to "Button - Primary"
   - **Ctrl+Alt+K** → Create Component

Below the button, add:
- "Forgot password?" — Inter Medium, 14px, color `#6366F1` (link style)

At the bottom of the screen, add:
- "Don't have an account? **Sign Up**" — Regular text + bold colored text
  - "Don't have an account? " — Inter Regular, 14px, `#64748B`
  - "Sign Up" — Inter SemiBold, 14px, `#6366F1`

Select Sign Up text together on one line.

steps.title: Final Assembly and Polish
steps.instructions:
Select ALL elements in the frame (Ctrl+A) → **Shift+A** to add Auto Layout to the entire frame.
- Direction: Vertical
- Padding: 48 top, 24 sides, 24 bottom
- Gap: 32 between major sections
- Alignment: Center

Adjust spacing:
- Logo section to Form: 48px gap
- Form to Button: 24px gap
- Button to Forgot Password: 16px gap
- Push "Don't have an account?" to bottom using spacer or fixed positioning

Final touches:
- Add a subtle shadow to the input fields: Effect → Drop Shadow → X:0, Y:1, Blur:2, `#00000008`
- Make sure all text is readable and well-spaced
- Check alignment — everything should be centered or left-aligned consistently

Rename your layers properly in the left panel.

**Preview:** Press Ctrl+P (Present) to see it as a real mobile screen.

**Export:** Select the frame → right panel → Export → 2x PNG

**Submit:** Share link (Share → Copy link) + exported PNG.

expected_output: A professional mobile login screen in Figma with logo, two input fields, login button (as a component), forgot password link, and sign-up link — all built with Auto Layout for responsive behavior
